selection_method: For each stable candidate_id, compute lowercase SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes '<seed>|<candidate_id>'; select the lexicographically smallest hexadecimal digest.
requirements: immediate visible peer help or acceptance
attached conversation image used only for main-subject appearance and visible identity

candidates.concept: An adult astronomy educator at a public planetarium outreach stage accidentally scatters lightweight foam constellation tiles, then returns them to a magnetic teaching board while an adult technician hands back the last tile under blue projector spill and warm aisle lights.
